items.text: Zay Flowers (hamstring) returned to practice Friday after consecutive DNPs Wed/Thu; limited early but encouraging for possible Week 2 vs Saints. Lane already IR.
items.why: First practice of week Friday per Hensley/Schefter; day-to-day prior.
items.implication: Likely GTD; if plays, WR1 role intact.
items.opportunity: If OUT reverse: Bateman hierarchy primary.

items.text: Nico Collins (hamstring, Grade 1) DNP Friday and not expected to play Week 2 vs Bengals after midweek injury; doctors initially said not serious but jeopardy confirmed. History of hamstring issues.
items.why: DNP Wed-Fri, Grade 1 strain midweek practice; Schefter/Wilson reports.

items.text: DJ Moore ruled OUT TNF with shoulder/AC joint sprain (not serious); day-to-day, chance next week vs Chargers but not lock.
items.why: Landed hard TNF; X-rays, stinger/AC sprain per Schefter/Rapoport.
items.opportunity: Other Bills WRs elevated for remainder.

items.text: Ladd McConkey (ribs) DNP multiple days including Thursday; Schefter: unlikely available Week 2 vs Raiders. Working side only.
items.why: Consecutive DNPs post-Week 1 exit; rib injury day-to-day but no progress.
items.implication: Misses vs LV; slot/route volume opens.

items.text: Falcons ruled OUT Michael Penix Jr Week 2 vs Panthers; Cooper Rush starts, Jack Strand backup.
items.why: Not ready; Rush first-team reps confirmed.
items.implication: Falcons offense with veteran QB; London/Pitts etc. stable.

items.text: Brock Bowers (knee/meniscus trim) returned to practice Friday first time since surgery; prior full DNPs. Possible Week 2 debut vs Chargers.
items.why: Spotted stretching/warmup Friday after missing Week 1 and practices; Kubiak hopeful timeline.
items.implication: If active, immediate TE1; else Mayer continues.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson ready for debut Week 2 vs PIT; unclear how much steals from Stevenson but timing perfect with AJ Brown IR and soft schedule stretch.
items.why: Self-said ready; Pats desperate for explosives post-Brown IR; matchups PIT-JAX-BUF etc before bye.
items.implication: Committee but explosive upside/handcuff value rises.

items.text: If Zay Flowers (hamstring) can't go, Ravens WR hierarchy: Bateman, Devontez Walker, Wester, Sarratt, Moore. Lane IR already.
items.why: Consecutive DNPs at time of post; clear depth chart if OUT.

items.text: ETR Week 2 waivers injury beneficiaries: McConkey=Tre Harris; Lane=Bateman/Moore; Brown=Doubs/Douglas; Kamara=Miller; plus streamers Wentz/Shough etc.
items.why: Precise injury fallout mapping for adds.

items.text: Dalton Kincaid LOVE vs DET: 69% routes (career high vs last yr), 77% snaps highest since 2024; DET allowed 27 to TEs Week 1.
items.why: Role expansion if healthy; efficiency history.

items.text: Kenneth Walker LOVE Week 2 vs IND: 21/24 RB touches, 74% snaps, 40% target share (tied lead) Week 1; Indy allowed 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry.
items.why: Elite usage + smash matchup; RB1 overall range outcomes.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty LOVE @ LAC: 99 utilization score Week 1 (tied Bijan lead); 19% target share recent, 25+ touches frequent.
items.why: Elite util under Kubiak; injury scare overblown.

items.text: Travis Etienne HATE @ BAL: matched Miller rushes Week 1, 69% pts air; Kamara return squeezes further; underdog script bad.
items.why: Committee + Kamara expected back + tough matchup/script.
